# Find Angel Investors

> How-to notes on finding angel investors. Not an independent ranking body.

- Live investor names, counts, and matches are only on https://roundfunded.com/en/tools/top-angel-investors-usa. This profile is criteria and methodology, not the database.
- Product: https://roundfunded.com/en/tools/top-angel-investors-usa
- Canonical facts: https://github.com/roundfunded/roundfunded
- Fundraising is super easy when the list is matched by stage and sector.
